# Market brief — Wednesday 2026-09-30 7:30 ET

## Calendar — next 5 market days (chronological)
**Wed 2026-09-30**
- 08:15 ET — ADP employment change (Sep; cons. ~70k vs prior 38k) — private-payroll sneak peek
- 08:30 ET — GDP third estimate (Q2; cons. ~1.5% QoQ SAAR vs 2.1% second) — growth revision
- 08:30 ET — PCE / core PCE (Aug; cons. 0.4%/0.3% MoM, 3.7%/3.3% YoY) — Fed inflation gauge
- 08:30 ET — Personal income / spending (Aug; cons. ~0.4% / ~0.8%) — demand pulse
- Quarter-end — index futures / institutional rebalance — market-structure flow
- 13:30–18:00 ET — Barkin, Cook, Goolsbee, Kashkari remarks — FOMC-adjacent tone

**Thu 2026-10-01**
- 08:30 ET — Initial jobless claims (week of Sep 26) — labor softness check
- 10:00 ET — ISM Manufacturing PMI (Sep; cons. ~55 vs 54.6) — factory pulse
- 10:00 ET — Construction spending (Aug) — building activity
- afternoon — Williams / Cook on panels — voting-member tone

**Fri 2026-10-02**
- 08:30 ET — Nonfarm payrolls / unemployment (Sep; cons. ~100k / 4.1%) — labor print
- 08:30 ET — Average hourly earnings (Sep; cons. 0.3% MoM) — wage inflation
- 10:00 ET — Durable goods / factory orders (Aug) — capex follow-through

**Mon 2026-10-05**
- 10:00 ET — ISM Services PMI (Sep) — dominant-sector activity

**Tue 2026-10-06**
- 08:30 ET — International trade in goods and services (Aug) — external balance

(CPI Oct 14; PPI/retail Oct 15; monthly equity OPEX Fri Oct 16. Next FOMC Oct 27–28; minutes Oct 7. No quad-witching in this window.)

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days
**2026-09-29** — TMC — 8-K: Liam Mallon appointed director; NOAA FR publication of USA-A application and USA-B EIS NOI — confirmed.
**~Oct 2026** — TMC — NOAA certification of USA-A — estimated.
**Window overlapping next 30d** — ASTS — BB14-16 production / possible later Falcon 9 slot — inferred; no company NET in 30d.
**2026-10-16** — IWM — monthly equity OPEX — confirmed.
ASTS: no dated events found in 30d.
TMC: $11.50 warrants expired 2026-09-09. No additional firm ISA/vessel/Crucible dates in 30d.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)
ASTS: Yao (CTO) 10b5-1 sale 40,000 @ $58.93 on 16 Sep, remaining 34,750. Gupta (COO) sale 12,000 @ $58.89, remaining 462,980. Filed 17 Sep.
TMC: Hall RSU 72,935 on 11 Sep; Mallon RSU awards in 8-K. No TMC open-market in 14d.

## Rates and bonds
10y ~5.24–5.26%; 2y ~4.89–4.94%; 10y–2y ~+32–37 bp (not inverted). 5y TIPS real ~2.72% vs 5y nominal ~5.06%; 5y BE ~2.34%; 10y BE ~2.35%. Real yields driving the backup; breakevens anchored near 2.3%.

## USD/JPY
Spot ~156.9–157.1 vs ~157.3 overnight. Off Sep 1 ~160, bounce from ~153.5 mid-month. No fresh BoJ intervention chatter.

## Equities tape
SPX 7,670.84 (−0.17%); ES +0.2%. Nasdaq 26,797.54; NDX ~30,339. IWM 279.01 (~8.6% below mid-Aug peak). VIX 16.04. Breadth not cleanly sourced pre-open; IWM lagging.

## Names / themes only if material overnight
TMC Sep 29 8-K (Mallon + NOAA FR). ASTS Sep 28 8-K was severance policy.

## What actually matters this morning
- ADP then GDP third + August PCE
- Quarter-end flow
- NFP Friday
- TMC NOAA cert still October estimated
- ASTS no dated launch today

# Market brief — Thursday 2026-10-01 7:30 ET

## Calendar — next 5 market days (chronological)
**Thu 2026-10-01**
- 08:30 ET — Initial jobless claims (week of Sep 26; cons. 205k vs prior 197k) — labor softness check
- 08:30 ET — Continuing claims (prior 1,719k) — benefit duration
- 09:45 ET — S&P manufacturing PMI final (Sep; prior flash 53.9) — factory revision
- 10:00 ET — ISM manufacturing (Sep; cons. 54 vs prior 54.6) — factory pulse
- 10:00 ET — Construction spending (Aug; prior −0.5%) — building activity

**Fri 2026-10-02**
- 08:30 ET — Nonfarm payrolls (Sep; cons. 90k vs prior 162k) — labor print
- 08:30 ET — Unemployment rate (Sep; cons. 4.1% vs prior 4.1%) — slack gauge
- 08:30 ET — Average hourly earnings (Sep) — wage inflation
- 10:00 ET — Factory orders (Aug; prior 0.9%) — capex follow-through

**Mon 2026-10-05**
- 09:45 ET — S&P services PMI final (Sep) — services revision
- 10:00 ET — ISM services (Sep; prior 55.4) — dominant-sector activity

**Tue 2026-10-06**
- 08:30 ET — Trade balance (Aug; prior −$88.6B) — external balance

**Wed 2026-10-07**
- 14:00 ET — FOMC minutes (Sep 15–16 meeting) — hike-path debate
- 15:00 ET — Consumer credit (Aug; prior $18.1B) — household credit

No ADP today (printed Wed). No CPI/PPI, no Fed decision, no quad/triple witching or monthly OPEX in this window. Monthly equity OPEX is Fri Oct 16. Next FOMC decision Oct 28. No voting-FOMC speech reconfirmed for this window. Claims and ISM have not printed as of 7:30 ET.

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days
**Window through Oct 2026** — TMC — NOAA certification of USA-A application — estimated — Q2 2026 call (NOAA guidance; administrative delay, not a dated Federal Register day).
**Window overlapping next 30d** — ASTS — BlueBird 14–16 manufacture / ship readiness — inferred — company said BB14 complete and 15–16 nearing completion; no SpaceX or company NET in this window.
**2026-10-16** — IWM / index options — monthly equity OPEX — confirmed — standard third-Friday expiration (not a company event).
**2026-10-29 to 2026-10-30** — BoJ — policy meeting and Outlook Report — confirmed — BoJ calendar; topic may arise for USDJPY, not ASTS/TMC.
ASTS: no dated events found in 30d. Q3 earnings estimates (Nov 10 Quartr / Nov 16 TipRanks, AMC) sit outside the window. Last company-dated launch was BlueBird 11–13 on Aug 5.
TMC: $11.50 public and private warrants expired 2026-09-09 (Form 25 / warrant agreement). No new ISA session, vessel/Allseas, Korea Zinc, or Project Crucible date inside 30d. Crucible FONSI was Sep 11; production target remains 2029.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)
Open-market / 10b5-1, then grants. No open-market buys found.

ASTS
- Huiwen Yao, CTO — open-market sale, aggregator-labeled 10b5-1 — 40,000 Class A at weighted avg $58.93 (range $57.52–$60.31) — about $2.36M — remaining direct 34,750 — txn 2026-09-16, filed 2026-09-17 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001780312/000149315226043183/xslF345X06/ownership.xml
- Shanti B. Gupta, COO — code S sale (10b5-1 box not clearly checked on the OTC HTML) — 12,000 Class A at $58.89 (range $58.87–$58.93) — about $0.71M — remaining direct 462,980 — txn 2026-09-16, filed 2026-09-17.
No ASTS Form 4/144 found with a filing date after 2026-09-17.

TMC
- Andrew Hall, director — RSU grant, not a purchase — 72,935 common at $0 — vest on third anniversary — remaining direct 466,993 — txn 2026-09-11, filed 2026-09-16.
- Gerard Barron 13D/A (filed around 2026-09-11) reports 89,394 warrants at $11.50 expired unexercised on 2026-09-09. 13D is not a Form 4.
TMC: no open-market Form 4 purchase or sale in the last ~14d.

## Rates and bonds
10y about 5.32–5.33% early Thursday (LSEG/TheStreet), up ~3–4 bp on the day and ~4 bp on the week from a ~5.28–5.29% Wednesday settle; highest since 2002 on those quotes. 2y about 4.88–4.89% (Wed close 4.883%, little changed). 10y–2y about +43 to +45 bp, not inverted. 5y5y forward inflation not freshly sourced this morning; Wednesday tape had 5y and 10y breakevens near 2.3% with the backup in real yields. Growth data are the near catalyst; breakevens are not the thing that broke.

## USD/JPY
Spot near 158.33 on Oct 1 (EBC), up from about 157.4 into the Tankan and from the high-156s/low-157s late Wednesday. Short trend is a grind back toward 160 after the late-July joint intervention (pair had been near 164, then ~152–155). MoF/Treasury still describe the yen as undervalued; 160 is the chatter line. BoJ policy rate 1.25% vs Fed 3.75–4.00%. Friday payrolls are the next US-yield test.

## Equities tape
SPX 7,651.54 Wednesday (−0.25%); about 1.9% under the Aug 13 52-week high 7,798.99. NDX 30,408.50 (+0.23%). IWM close $277.89 / NAV $277.88 (−0.35%); 52-week high $304.98, so about 8.9% under that peak. Russell 2000 index 2,796.86 vs a cited record 3,068. At 04:48 ET, Dow futures −0.52%, S&P futures −0.02%, Nasdaq 100 futures +0.29% (Reuters). Breadth: Wednesday NYSE decliners led 1.66-to-1; Nasdaq 1.51-to-1. % above 50d/200d not sourced. Equal-weight lagged (Saxo: S&P equal-weight −0.75% vs S&P −0.25%). VIX 16.34 close, 16.84 premarket, contango — elevated but not a stress regime.

## Names / themes only if material overnight
No ASTS or TMC headline, filing, or outsized move found overnight. Micron results and Alphabet Gemini 4 were the index-level items; oil firmer (WTI ~$92). Not watchlist.

## What actually matters this morning
- 08:30 claims and 10:00 ISM manufacturing, with the 10-year already at a multi-decade high near 5.33%.
- Friday 08:30 September payrolls (cons. 90k vs prior 162k) as the rates and USDJPY event.
- USDJPY near 158.3 and verbal intervention risk into 160 if yields extend.
- TMC NOAA USA-A certification still an October estimate, not a dated print today.
- ASTS: no dated launch or FCC item today; BB14–16 remains an undated production window.
